name_ms: Rasa ingin tahu dan pembelajaran sepanjang hayat
definition_en: The ability and willingness to continuously seek new knowledge, acquire new skills, and adapt one's understanding in response to changing contexts.
definition_ms: Keupayaan dan kesediaan untuk terus mencari ilmu baharu, mempelajari kemahiran baharu, serta menyesuaikan pemahaman mengikut perubahan keadaan.
typical_tasks_en:
• Spend a weekend learning the new data visualisation tool before the training session.
• Ask follow-up questions in the workshop to understand how AI could help the team.
• Research Malaysian labour law updates and share findings with HR.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Luangkan hujung minggu mempelajari alat visualisasi data baharu sebelum sesi latihan.
• Tanya soalan susulan dalam bengkel untuk memahami bagaimana AI boleh membantu pasukan.
• Kaji kemas kini undang-undang buruh Malaysia dan kongsi penemuan dengan HR.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires learning new concepts, tools, or methods
• The task involves actively seeking information beyond what is required
• The task requires updating existing knowledge or skills
• The task involves exploring unfamiliar topics or domains
• The task requires asking questions and pursuing deeper understanding
exclusion_rules:
• The task relies entirely on existing knowledge with no new learning
• The user performs repetitive work without seeking improvement
• The task involves no exploration or inquiry beyond immediate requirements
• The user is resistant to updating methods or acquiring new skills
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task uses existing knowledge only, with no learning, exploration, or inquiry.

confusions.boundary_rule: Curiosity drives learning. Technological literacy is the resulting competence with tools.
confusions.example_task: Explore new productivity apps and learn to use the most promising one.
confusions.expected_labels: Curiosity and lifelong learning; Technological literacy

confusions.boundary_rule: Curiosity is about seeking knowledge. Resilience is about adapting to change.
confusions.example_task: Learn about a new market trend to prepare for potential industry shifts.
confusions.expected_labels: Curiosity and lifelong learning; Resilience, flexibility and agility

confusions.boundary_rule: Curiosity is outward-looking inquiry. Motivation is inward-looking drive.
confusions.example_task: I am motivated to improve, so I ask questions about best practices.
confusions.expected_labels: Curiosity and lifelong learning; Motivation and self-awareness
